summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for a cracking local encounter against New Mills on Tuesday evening at Hind Heath Road (7.45pm kick-off), with both sides looking to build on their recent success in the upper reaches of the league. There's cause for celebration at the club after midfielder Cain Harry reached the milestone of 100 competitive games in a Sandbach shirt, joining an exclusive group of just 14 players in the club's history to achieve the feat. Tickets are available at reasonable prices with adults paying £6, concessions £5 and under-16s just £2.
